name: armada-t1
description: Blackspark Armada T1 — agent workflows for Canadian T1 tax files. Includes `gather`: interview a taxpayer, attach source documents, build the input records, flag gaps as tasks, and hand off a tax file whose inputs are complete, ready for the preparation stage of your workflow. Carries the Armada T1 MCP connection itself, pinned to production.

interface.shortDescription: Gather Canadian T1 tax files with an agent
interface.longDescription: Blackspark Armada T1 brings the Armada tax platform into your agent. The gather skill runs a taxpayer intake interview: it reads the slips and receipts a firm hands over, writes structured input records into Armada, attaches each source document for provenance, raises anything ambiguous as a task rather than guessing, and hands off a tax file whose inputs are complete, ready for the preparation stage of your workflow. Preparation, review and filing stay in the firm's own tax software — this builds the inputs. Every user authenticates individually against Armada ID, so roles and tenant scoping apply exactly as they do in the web app.
defaultPrompt: Gather a 2025 tax file for a new client from the slips I'm about to share.
Which sections of this tax file are still incomplete, and what's blocking Prepare?
Attach these T4 and T5 slips to the client's file and record where each figure came from.
